MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next addition because it brings door alerts and two-way audio to the Alexa setup I have recently been building.",
    "Alexa-compatible security and lighting fit my interests because they give my existing devices additional uses, although I would start with one useful addition."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "An older Echo Dot, another streaming stick, and another Echo display feel redundant after my recent fourth-generation Dot, Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle, and Show 5 with its stand.",
    "Another card reader and larger memory cards resemble past purchases, but I have no current replacement or storage need.",
    "Whole-home bundles and three indoor cameras go beyond my immediate interest in trying a doorbell; interest in home security does not mean I want several cameras now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Alexa purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to offer more speakers and displays, even when they repeat functions I recently chose.",
    "My older storage-accessory purchases seem to imply an ongoing need for card readers and memory cards, without a specific task that would make them useful now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent device choices matter: a useful addition to what I have is more appealing than an older version or another device serving the same purpose.",
    "The size and purpose of the purchase matter to me: one doorbell addresses a clear use, while multiple cameras require needs I have not expressed.",
    "My recent Show 5 stand fits a device I had just chosen; that kind of directly useful accessory makes more sense than another display with an auto-renewing trial."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and practical electronics but too often repeat recent purchases instead of identifying a useful next addition."
}
